python -u - <<'PY'
import ctypes, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, sqlite3, ssl, subprocess, sys, tempfile
packaging_check = subprocess.run(['py3compile', '-p', 'python'], env={**os.environ, 'PYCOMPILE_DEBUG':'1'}, capture_output=True, text=True)
packaging = {'exitCode':packaging_check.returncode, 'stdout':packaging_check.stdout[-2000:], 'stderr':packaging_check.stderr[-5000:]}
assert packaging_check.returncode == 0, packaging
assert os.getuid() >= 10000
assert os.environ['LD_PRELOAD'].endswith('/libarxdpreload.so')
sample = pathlib.Path(os.environ['PREFIX']) / 'share/arxd-python-probe.txt'
sample.write_text('Arxd Python π\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert sample.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == 'Arxd Python π\n'
sample.unlink()
child = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', 'print(6 * 7)'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
assert child.stdout.strip() == '42'
clean = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', 'print(8 * 8)'], env={}, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
assert clean.stdout.strip() == '64'
shell = subprocess.run('python -c "print(6 * 7)"', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
assert shell.stdout.strip() == '42'
with sqlite3.connect(':memory:') as db:
 assert db.execute('select 6 * 7').fetchone()[0] == 42
print(json.dumps({'packaging':packaging,'probe':'python','version':sys.version,'executable':sys.executable,'uid':os.getuid(),'child':child.stdout.strip(),'cleanChild':clean.stdout.strip(),'shellChild':shell.stdout,'ssl':ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION,'sqlite':sqlite3.sqlite_version,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b'arxd').hexdigest()}))
PY

set -eu
python - <<'PYTEST'
import ctypes, errno, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
base = pathlib.Path(os.environ['TMPDIR']) / 'arxd-exec-probes'
base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
nested = base / 'mkdir-parent/child'
subprocess.run(['mkdir', '-p', str(nested)], check=True)
assert nested.is_dir()
nested.rmdir()
nested.parent.rmdir()
plain = base / 'plain-script'
plain.write_text("printf 'fallback-ok\n'\n")
plain.chmod(0o700)
child = """import ctypes, os, sys
lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
args = (ctypes.c_char_p * 4)(b'python', b'-c', b'print(42)', None)
if sys.argv[1] == 'fallback':
    args = (ctypes.c_char_p * 2)(os.fsencode(sys.argv[2]), None)
    lib.execvp(os.fsencode(sys.argv[2]), args)
elif sys.argv[1] == 'fd':
    fd = os.open(sys.executable, os.O_RDONLY)
    env = (ctypes.c_char_p * 1)(None)
    lib.fexecve(fd, args, env)
else:
    lib.execv(os.fsencode(os.environ['PREFIX'] + '/bin/../bin/python'), args)
raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'exec failed')
"""
values = {name: subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, '-c', child, name, str(plain)], text=True).strip() for name in ('fallback', 'fd', 'normalized')}
assert values == {'fallback': 'fallback-ok', 'fd': '42', 'normalized': '42'}, values
lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
lib.posix_spawn.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int), ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p)]
pid = ctypes.c_int()
args = (ctypes.c_char_p * 4)(os.fsencode(sys.executable), b'-c', b'import sys; sys.exit(23)', None)
env = (ctypes.c_char_p * 1)(None)
error = lib.posix_spawn(ctypes.byref(pid), os.fsencode(sys.executable), None, None, args, env)
assert error == 0, error
spawn_status = os.waitpid(pid.value, 0)[1]
assert os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(spawn_status) == 23, {'pid': pid.value, 'status': spawn_status, 'exit': os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(spawn_status)}
plain.unlink()
base.rmdir()
print(json.dumps({'probe': 'exec', 'mkdirParents': True, **values, 'spawnExit': 23, 'uid': os.getuid()}))
PYTEST
